_comment: A pinned, unmodified copy of three Learn pages, as their source in MicrosoftDocs/entra-docs: 'Secure user-based service accounts in Active Directory' (Get-ADObject and Get-ADUser commands that find user accounts used as service accounts), 'Secure group managed service accounts' (Get-ADServiceAccount commands that find MSAs and gMSAs) and 'Securing service principals in Microsoft Entra ID' (Get-MgServicePrincipal commands). The commands exist only inside these pages. Never edit these files: update the snapshot by copying a newer upstream commit and regenerating this manifest in a reviewed pull request. scripts/tests/test_third_party_snapshots.py fails when a file stops matching its hash.
name: Learn samples: finding on-premises service accounts and service principals (Active Directory PowerShell and Microsoft Graph PowerShell)
license: Code: MIT (LICENSE-CODE). Documentation: MIT (LICENSE). Both copied from the repository root.
not_copied: The other pages in Learn's service account series (Securing on-premises service accounts, Govern on-premises service accounts, Secure standalone managed service accounts, Secure on-premises computer accounts, Governing Microsoft Entra service accounts): they hold no discovery commands the chapter runs; the chapter links them.
Everything else in MicrosoftDocs/entra-docs, including the pages' screenshots and include files; the chapter links Learn rather than quoting it.
